item.title: [Infraestrutura] CVE-2026-120203 - Docker
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-120203 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.8
Resumo:
ShowDoc 2.8.14 before 3.9.6 contains a code injection vulnerability in its Mock feature that allows authenticated users to execute shell commands through mockjs templates. Attackers can store a template via MockController::add with escaped parentheses that mockjs evaluates with eval(), then trigger it through MockController::infoByKey to run commands, as root in the official Docker image.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-120203

item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] CVE-2026-107342 - WordPress
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-107342 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 4.3
Resumo:
The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.30 does not perform a capability check when its test-email handler resolves and returns a user's email address, relying only on a nonce that is available to any logged-in user, allowing authenticated users with minimal privileges (Subscriber and above) to disclose the email address of any registered user, including administrators.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-107342
